crossRefs.note: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors…
God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings…
They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw the stone…
and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know…
Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by…
To them it was revealed, that they served not to themselves, but to you, in these things, which now have been announced…

translations.web: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat on it.
translations.bsb: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
translations.kjv: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
translations.asv: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.
